class.name: GodotDoctorNodeValidationWarning
class.brief_description: A warning associated with a [Node] in the scene tree. Clicking the warning selects [member origin_node] in the scene tree. Used by [GodotDoctorDock] to show validation warnings related to nodes.

method.name: _select_origin
method.description: Selects [member origin_node] in the scene tree editor.

members.member: The node that caused the warning.
The root node of the scene that contains [member origin_node].
